aircraft_name: Depict a Rockwell Commander 114: compact four-seat aircraft with exactly two seating rows, a broad enclosed cabin, low mildly tapered wings, one nose-mounted piston engine and tractor propeller, and a conventional swept-fin tail. Landing gear fully retracted. Keep the cabin short; do not add a third seating row or stretch it into a six-seat transport. Use white with restrained burgundy trim.

Depict a Rockwell/Gulfstream 695 Jetprop Commander: slender business-aircraft fuselage with a long pointed nose, compact pressurized cabin and relatively large rectangular cabin windows. High-mounted straight wings carry exactly two tractor turboprops. Conventional single-fin tail with low horizontal stabilizers; landing gear retracted. No deep commuter-airliner fuselage or long row of small oval windows. Use white with dark-green trim.

Depict an Acro Sport I: compact single-seat aerobatic biplane with exactly one open cockpit, two strut-and-wire-braced wings, one nose-mounted horizontally opposed piston engine and tractor propeller, and a conventional tail. Fixed main landing gear and tailwheel remain extended. No second cockpit, passenger seat, or stretched tandem-cockpit fuselage. Use red and cream.

Depict a Piper Aerostar 600: streamlined compact six-seat cabin twin with a pointed unpowered nose, straight mid-mounted wings, exactly two wing-mounted piston engines and tractor propellers, and a conventional swept-fin tail. Landing gear retracted. Wings must attach around mid-fuselage height, not at the belly. Preserve the short cabin; no extended commuter window row. Use white with burgundy trim.

Depict a CAIGA AG100 light training aircraft: a compact three-seat aircraft with an enclosed glazed cabin, low-mounted wings, exactly one nose-mounted piston engine driving one tractor propeller, and a single vertical tail fin. Reproduce the actual AG100’s cabin glazing, wing planform, and horizontal-stabilizer placement rather than substituting a generic Cirrus airframe. Fixed tricycle landing gear must remain extended in flight, with a proportionate nosewheel and two main wheels. Preserve the compact trainer fuselage; do not stretch the cabin or add passenger-window rows. Show the complete aircraft facing left in direct side profile, with realistic spinning-propeller motion blur. Use a plausible white paint scheme with restrained red and charcoal accents, rendered in subtle colored pencil. No wing-mounted engines, jet nacelles, floats, or additional propellers.

Depict a Beechcraft 1900D: nineteen-passenger commuter aircraft with a slender fuselage, tall stand-up cabin and approximately nine passenger windows per side. Low largely straight tapered wings carry exactly two tractor turboprops. T-tail; landing gear fully retracted. Preserve nineteen-seat commuter proportions, not a much larger regional airliner with fifteen or more cabin windows. Use white with restrained dark-green airline accents.

Depict a Cessna 150: compact two-seat aircraft with exactly one side-by-side seating row, a short cabin, strut-braced high wings, one nose-mounted piston engine and two-bladed tractor propeller, and a conventional tail. Fixed tricycle landing gear remains extended. Rear-quarter glazing must not become a rear passenger compartment. No rear seating row or four-seat fuselage. Use white with red trim.

Depict a Cessna T303 Crusader: compact six-seat light twin with a pointed nose, short cabin, low tapered wings and exactly two wing-mounted piston engines with tractor propellers. Cruciform tail: horizontal stabilizer partway up the fin with substantial fin extending above it. Landing gear retracted. No fin-top T-tail or stretched commuter cabin. Use white with burgundy trim.

Depict a Cessna 177RG Cardinal RG: four-seat cabin, high cantilever wing without external support struts, one nose-mounted piston engine and tractor propeller, swept vertical fin and low all-moving stabilator. Show all retractable landing gear fully stowed in flight. Absolutely no exposed wheels, wheel pants or fixed landing-gear legs. Use white with dark-green trim.

Depict a Rutan Model 40 Defiant: enclosed four-seat cabin, forward canard, low swept main wings aft of the cabin and vertical fins at the two main-wing tips. Exactly two centerline piston engines: nose tractor propeller and aft pusher propeller. Fixed main gear remains extended; retractable nosegear is raised. No central rear fin, conventional aft tailplane, third fin or tail extension behind the pusher propeller. Use white with restrained red accents.

Depict an Eclipse 500: very compact narrow business-jet fuselage with a short passenger cabin and three cabin windows per side. Low essentially straight tapered wings, exactly two small aft-fuselage turbofans and a T-tail. Landing gear retracted. No five-window stretched cabin, canards or propellers. Preserve the proportions of a very light jet. Use white with burgundy accents.

Depict a Grob G 109B touring motor glider: two seats side by side in one row beneath a broad canopy, slender fuselage and long tail boom, very long high-aspect-ratio low wings, one nose-mounted piston engine and tractor propeller, and a T-tail. Fixed main wheels and rear tailwheel remain extended. No nosewheel or tandem cockpit. Use white with restrained red accents.

Depict a Grumman American GA-7 Cougar: compact four-seat cabin with exactly two seating rows, low lightly tapered wings, exactly two wing-mounted piston engines and tractor propellers, and a conventional swept-fin tail with low horizontal stabilizers. Landing gear retracted. No elongated multirow passenger cabin, commuter window row, turboprop nacelles or T-tail. Use white with dark-green trim.

Depict a Malmö MFI-9 / Bölkow Bo 208 Junior: compact two-seat side-by-side cockpit beneath a canopy, shoulder-mounted wings with slight forward sweep, one nose-mounted piston engine and tractor propeller, and a conventional tail. Fixed tricycle landing gear remains extended. No low-mounted wings, rear seating row or stretched cabin. Use white with red trim.

Depict a Lake LA-4 Buccaneer: compact enclosed cabin, stepped boat-shaped hull, low-mounted cantilever wings with outboard stabilizing floats, and one pylon-mounted piston engine above the fuselage driving a rear-facing pusher propeller. Single vertical fin with an elevated cruciform horizontal stabilizer below the fin tip. Retract amphibious wheels. No high parasol wing, external wing bracing or twin engines. Use white with burgundy accents.

Depict a Rutan Long-EZ: slender tandem two-seat canopy, forward canard, swept main wings aft of the cockpit, and one rear-mounted piston engine with pusher propeller. Exactly two vertical fins, each attached to a main-wing tip. Fixed main gear remains extended; nosegear retracted. In side view allow natural overlap, but do not relocate a wingtip fin onto an engine-side tail extension. No central fin or conventional aft tailplane. Use white with red accents.

Depict a Lancair ES: compact four-seat composite cabin with exactly two seating rows, low tapered wings, one nose-mounted piston engine and tractor propeller, and a conventional swept-fin tail. Fixed tricycle landing gear with wheel fairings remains extended. No third seating row, stretched six-seat cabin or retractable-gear underside. Use white with dark-green accents.

Depict a Mooney M20K: compact four-seat cabin, low tapered wings, one nose-mounted turbocharged piston engine and tractor propeller, and low horizontal tail. Reproduce the distinctive Mooney vertical-fin silhouette: nearly upright leading edge and forward-sloping trailing edge, not a conventionally rearward-swept fin. Landing gear fully retracted. Use white with burgundy trim.

Depict a Dyn'Aéro MCR-4S: compact four-seat composite aircraft with two seating rows, low-mounted wings, one nose-mounted piston engine and tractor propeller, and a defining T-tail with the horizontal stabilizer mounted atop the vertical fin. Fixed tricycle landing gear remains extended. No low-mounted horizontal tailplane or elongated passenger cabin. Use white with restrained red accents.

Depict a Best Off Nynja: compact enclosed two-seat side-by-side cabin with one seating row, slender rear fuselage, strut-braced high wing, one nose-mounted piston engine and tractor propeller, and conventional tail. Fixed tricycle gear only: one nosewheel and two main wheels. No rear passenger row, tailwheel or extra landing-gear assemblies. Use white with green accents.

Depict a Piper PA-28-236 Dakota: compact four-seat cabin with exactly two seating rows and the characteristic PA-28 side glazing, low wings with tapered outer panels, one nose-mounted piston engine and tractor propeller, and conventional low stabilator. Fixed tricycle landing gear remains extended. No stretched six-seat Cherokee Six cabin or third passenger-window bay. Use cream-white with burgundy trim.

Depict a Quickie Q2: compact two-seat side-by-side bubble canopy, one nose-mounted piston engine and tractor propeller, and tandem lifting surfaces. The low forward canard carries the main wheels near its tips; the higher aft main wing attaches directly to the fuselage behind the cockpit. Single vertical fin and tailwheel. No nosewheel, parasol wing, wing-support struts or conventional horizontal tailplane. Use white with red accents.

Depict a Fournier RF-10 touring motor glider: two seats side by side in one row beneath a shared broad canopy, slender fuselage, long high-aspect-ratio low wings, one nose-mounted piston engine and tractor propeller, and a T-tail. Preserve the tailwheel landing-gear arrangement; do not add a nosewheel. No tandem cockpit or extra seating row. Use white with burgundy accents.
Depict a Stinson  S10: single-engine, high-wing light utility monoplane tail dragger with fixed forward wheels.

Depict a Cirrus SF50 Vision Jet: compact rounded pressurized cabin, low tapered wings, exactly one turbofan in a dorsal nacelle above the aft fuselage, and a distinctive V-tail. Landing gear fully retracted. Absolutely no external propeller, translucent propeller disc, rotating blade traces or rotor blur. The nacelle must end in a normal jet exhaust. Use white with burgundy and charcoal accents.

Depict a turbine-converted Cessna 210 Centurion: compact six-seat Centurion cabin retaining normal C210 fuselage length, high-mounted wing, one nose-mounted turboprop with model-correct intake and exhaust features, and conventional single-fin tail. Landing gear fully retracted. The conversion may extend the engine nose, but must not stretch the passenger cabin or add a commuter-style window row. Use white with dark-green trim.

Depict a SOCATA TB21 Trinidad TC: compact broad four/five-seat cabin with exactly two seating rows and characteristic Trinidad glazing, low substantially unswept wings, one nose-mounted turbocharged piston engine and tractor propeller, and conventional swept-fin tail with low horizontal surfaces. Landing gear fully retracted. No stretched three-row cabin or additional passenger-window bay. Use white with burgundy trim.

Depict a Rutan VariEze: compact tandem two-seat canopy, forward canard, low aft swept main wings, exactly two vertical fins mounted at the main-wing tips, and one rear-mounted piston engine with pusher propeller. Fixed main gear remains extended; retractable nosegear raised. No central vertical fin, third fin, conventional horizontal tail or tail extension behind the propeller. Use white with restrained red accents.
Vashon Ranger R7, High wing, single engine, fixed tricycle gear light sport aircraft. Green trim

Depict a Liberty Aerospace XL2: compact two-seat cabin with exactly one side-by-side seating row beneath rounded glazing, low essentially unswept wings, one nose-mounted piston engine and tractor propeller, and conventional single-fin tail with low stabilator. Fixed tricycle landing gear remains extended. No rear seats, second cabin row or stretched four-seat fuselage. Use white with dark-green accents.
